entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the record.

2. The instant bail application has been filed on behalf of the applicant with a prayer to release him
on bail in Case Crime No. 173 of 2024, registered under Sections 498A, 304B I.P.C. and Section 3/4
of Dp Act, Police Station Nautanwa, District Maharajganj during pendency of the trial.

3. Allegation in the Fir is that informant's daughter was married with the applicant's son three
years before.

After marriage, the in-laws members tortured her for additional demand of dowry and on account of non fulfillment of demand, the in-laws members murdered the informant's daughter,
hence, the present FIR.

Shamsher vs State Of U.P. on 6 November, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/117413376/
1 4.
Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that the applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated in the present case due to ulterior motive.
Applicant is father-in-law of the deceased.
Cause of death of the deceased is due to asphyxia as a result of ante mortem hanging.
Applicant has no concern with the alleged incident.
Applicant has been implicated being father-in-law of the deceased.
Allegation alleged in FIR regarding demand of dowry is totally false and baseless.
Applicant has no previous criminal history.

Co-accused, namely, Sona @ Sonwa @ Langadi, who is mother-in-law of the accused, has been granted bail by this Court vide order dated 18.09.2024 and the applicant is father-in-law, whose case is similar to the co-accused, hence, applicant is also entitled to be enlarged on bail on the ground of same footing.
The applicant is languishing in jail since 03.06.2024.
In case, the applicant is released on bail, he will not misuse the liberty of bail and co-operate in trial.
5. Learned A.G.A. has opposed the bail prayer of the applicant.

6. Considering the material available on record and keeping in view the nature of the offence,
argument advanced on behalf of the parties, evidence on record regarding complicity of the accused and without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, the Court is of the view that the applicant has made out a case for bail.
The bail application is allowed.

7. Let the applicant, Shamsher, who is involved in the aforesaid case crime, be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned subject to following conditions.
Further, before issuing the release order, the sureties be verified.
i. The applicant shall not tamper with the prosecution evidence by intimidating/ pressurizing the witnesses, during the investigation or trial.
ii. The applicant shall cooperate in the trial sincerely without seeking any adjournment.
iii. The applicant shall not indulge in any criminal activity or commission of any crime after being released on bail.
8. In case of breach of any of the above conditions, it shall be a ground for cancellation of bail.

Order Date :- 6.11.2024 Nitin Verma  Shamsher vs State Of U.P. on 6 November, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/117413376/
